note: Semantic rename map for src/, recovered mechanically by anchor alignment from the committed slices (tools/recover-scoped-map.mjs): the token streams of a slice and its readable range must be identical in every non-identifier position, so every differing identifier pair is a proven rename, not a guess. `files` is a word-boundary map, used only where a name means the same thing everywhere in the slice and is never a property or object key; `scoped` addresses the rest by exact token index as { name: [[i, target], …] }. tools/derive.mjs re-applies this map when it re-cuts src/ (index-validated), tools/verify-rename.mjs and tools/audit.js re-prove every slice from it, and tools/check-chunk.mjs proves cross-slice references still resolve. Regenerate with `node tools/recover-scoped-map.mjs` after any rename batch.
